findings.location: src/fleet_graph/supervision_mcp.py:3 (claimed `fleet-graph supervision serve`) and src/fleet_graph/cli.py (no matching subcommand)
findings.summary: The deliverable read-only MCP surface is not servable in the fleet: `fleet-graph supervision serve` (the entry the module docstring claims is '唯一入口') is not a registered subcommand in cli.py (no `supervision` parser exists, only `decision serve`/`dd serve`/`goal serve`/`research serve`/`state serve`), and no `deploy/systemd/fleet-graph-supervision.service` unit template ships. Every other MCP surface is guarded by tests/test_deploy_unit.py (subcommand must be one the CLI accepts); a cold-start supervisor therefore has no process it can actually call.

findings.location: src/fleet_graph/supervision_mcp.py:503 (serve never passes repo_path/main_head) and _main_head at src/fleet_graph/supervision_mcp.py:394-411
findings.summary: Spec deliverable item 8 requires the authoritative fact '当前 main' (anchor of '判「修复到底生效没有」'), but serve() builds SupervisionConfig with repo_path=None/main_head=None, so releases.main is structurally always returned as unavailable on the deployed path (a wiring gap, not an upstream outage) — failing '每一项都是权威值而非线索'. The DI seam exists and is unit-tested via injected main_head, but production never supplies it.
